claims.raw_snippet: 3 Users / 1 Account 25 monthly credits

claims.claim: The Plus plan lists at $99 per month billed monthly, or $89 per month billed yearly, and includes 225 monthly credits.
claims.raw_snippet: Monthly Yearly $99 Per month $89 Per month 3 Users / 2 Accounts 225 monthly credits

claims.claim: The Admin API is rate limited: 500 hourly requests on the free plan, and paid plans begin at 2000 per hour.
claims.raw_snippet: The free plan includes 500 hourly requests, while the hourly rate-limit for those on paid plans begins at 2000.

claims.claim: Cloudinary's official documentation home is at cloudinary.com/documentation, and Cloudinary's REST API base path is api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/{cloud_name}/ with resources like /image/upload, /image/destroy, /resources/{resource_type}, and delivery URLs at res.cloudinary.com/{cloud_name}/.
claims.raw_snippet: Cloudinary documentation https://cloudinary.com https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/{cloud_name}/image/upload https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/{cloud_name}/image/destroy https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/{cloud_name}/resources/{resource_type} https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/{config[ https://res.cloudinary.com/{cloud_name}/image/upload https://res.cloudinary.com/{cloud_name}/image/upload/{transformations}/{public_id}.{format} https://res.cloudinary.com/{cloud_name}/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto/{public_id} https://res.cloudinary.com/{cloud_name}/image/upload/w_800,q_auto,f_auto/{public_id} https://res.cloudinary.com/{cloud_name}/image/upload/w_800,c_fill/l_text:Heebo_40_bold:%D7%A9%D7%9C%D7%95%D7%9D,co_white,g_south,y_30/{public_id} https://res.cloudinary.com/{cloud_name}/image/upload/e_gen_remove:prompt_(person https://res.cloudinary.com/{cloud}/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto/{public_id} https://res.cloudinary.com/{cloud}/video/upload/so_5,w_800,h_450,c_fill,q_auto,f_jpg/{video_id}

claims.claim: Adding q_auto and f_auto shrinks a sample 0.68 MB JPG to about 0.16 MB (~75% smaller), with f_auto causing most browsers to receive AVIF or WebP instead of the original JPG.
claims.raw_snippet: q_auto keeps the visual quality nearly identical despite the significantly smaller file size, while f_auto causes most browsers to receive it as AVIF (or WebP) rather than the original JPG.

claims.claim: WebP achieves 25%-34% smaller file sizes than JPEG at the same SSIM index.
claims.raw_snippet: WebP achieves 25%-34% smaller file sizes compared to JPEG at the same Structural Similarity (SSIM) index, indicating better compression.

claims.claim: Google auto-tagging returns a numerical confidence score per detected category, where 1.0 means 100% confidence; the auto_tagging parameter assigns tags from those categories.
claims.raw_snippet: The confidence score is a numerical value that represents the confidence level of the detected category, where 1.0 means 100% confidence.

claims.claim: Cloudinary requires the upload_large chunked-upload method for any file larger than 100 MB. Per-plan file-size caps are not published in the public docs.
claims.raw_snippet: The upload_large method uploads a large file to the cloud in chunks, and is required for any files that are larger than 100 MB.
claims.verification_note: CORRECTION: the skill previously stated free-plan limits of 10MB image / 100MB video. The 10 MB figure could not be found in any Cloudinary documentation page, and the support article that was cited (support.cloudinary.com/hc/en-us/articles/202520592) returns HTTP 403 behind Cloudflare and cannot be verified. 100 MB is documented only as the chunked-upload threshold, not as a plan cap. SKILL.md and SKILL_HE.md were reworded to point users at their own Console Settings instead of quoting an unverifiable number.

claims.claim: One Cloudinary credit is interchangeable: 1,000 transformations OR 1GB managed storage OR 1GB video bandwidth (2GB video bandwidth on paid plans).
claims.raw_snippet: 1 credit = 1,000 transformations image and video processing OR 1GB managed storage for all digital assets OR 1GB video bandwidth high-performance CDN

claims.claim: Setting the invalidate parameter to true on upload invalidates the previous image throughout the CDN; propagation takes seconds to minutes, whereas a version change takes effect immediately.
claims.raw_snippet: you can set the invalidate parameter to true while uploading a new image in order to invalidate the previous image throughout the CDN. It usually takes between a few seconds and a few minutes for the invalidation to fully propagate through the CDN, while the version component takes effect immediately.

claims.claim: Common Hebrew-supporting fonts available through Cloudinary's l_text overlay (when uploaded as custom fonts or via Google Fonts integration): Heebo, Assistant, Rubik, David Libre, Frank Ruhl Libre, Suez One, Secular One. These are widely-used Hebrew web fonts on Google Fonts.
claims.raw_snippet: Heebo Assistant Rubik

claims.claim: A signed Cloudinary upload signs a Unix timestamp (seconds) which stays valid for one hour; the string to sign is hashed with SHA-1 or SHA-256 after appending the API secret.
claims.raw_snippet: Choose the Unix timestamp (seconds) you'll send in the upload. It stays valid for one hour.

claims.claim: The Admin API rate limit applies only to Admin API requests, not to Upload API requests; paid plans start at 2000 hourly requests.
claims.raw_snippet: This API rate limit refers only to Admin API requests, and not to requests that use the Upload API
